# KaTeX 0.18.9

Vendored from the official `katex@0.18.9` npm package with `npm pack --ignore-scripts`.
Included: `dist/katex.min.js`, `dist/katex.min.css`, `dist/fonts/`, and `LICENSE`.

- Project: https://katex.org/
- Source: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
- License: MIT; see the LICENSE file included in the npm distribution.

The archive pages do not load this library. Article pages load it only when
their Markdown contains math recognized by Arithmatex.
